items.exampleEn: This small camera has some limitations at night.
items.exampleZh: 這台小相機在晚上拍照有些限制。

items.exampleEn: There was a boom in online shopping last year.
items.exampleZh: 去年網路購物大幅成長。

items.exampleEn: Many young people are still dependent on their parents.
items.exampleZh: 很多年輕人仍然依賴父母。

items.exampleEn: The use of phones in class is widespread.
items.exampleZh: 上課用手機的情況很普遍。

items.exampleEn: The old factory went through a complete transformation into an art center.
items.exampleZh: 那間舊工廠徹底改造成了藝術中心。

items.exampleEn: The park restricts the number of visitors each day.
items.exampleZh: 這座公園限制每天的遊客人數。

items.exampleEn: Money was the biggest obstacle to our plan.
items.exampleZh: 錢是我們計畫最大的障礙。

items.exampleEn: The team won an overwhelming victory.
items.exampleZh: 這支隊伍贏得壓倒性的勝利。

items.sentenceEn: Language can be an obstacle when you work abroad.
items.sentenceZh: 在國外工作時，語言可能是一個障礙。

items.audioEn: The town's tourism boom began when a new train station opened.
items.audioZh: 新火車站開幕後，這個小鎮的觀光就開始蓬勃發展。
items.questionZh: 這個小鎮的觀光熱潮是什麼時候開始的？
options: When a movie was made there.
When the old train station closed.
After the town got a new station.

items.sentenceEn: Your success is dependent on how hard you work.
items.sentenceZh: 你能否成功取決於你有多努力。

items.sentenceEn: The rule restricts smoking to one small area.
items.sentenceZh: 這條規定只允許在一個小區域抽菸。

items.stemEn: Bad weather is a ____ problem in this area; it affects almost every town.
items.stemZh: 惡劣天氣在這個地區是普遍的問題，幾乎每個城鎮都受影響。

items.stemEn: Lack of time is the main ____ to learning a new skill.
items.stemZh: 缺乏時間是學習新技能的主要障礙。

items.passageEn: Ten years ago, our village by the sea was poor and dependent on fishing. Then a tourism boom began, and the village went through a big transformation. Numerous hotels and cafes opened, and the response from visitors was overwhelming. But there were also obstacles: traffic and trash became widespread problems. Now the village restricts the number of cars on weekends. Everyone agrees that growth has its limitations.
items.passageZh: 十年前，我們這個海邊的村子很窮，靠捕魚為生。後來觀光熱潮開始，村子經歷了巨大的轉變。許多飯店和咖啡店紛紛開張，遊客的反應熱烈得驚人。但也出現了一些障礙：交通和垃圾成了普遍的問題。現在村子在週末限制車輛的數量。大家都同意，成長也有它的限度。

questions.questionZh: 十年前這個村子靠什麼生活？
村子現在週末限制什麼？

items.promptZh: 這家公司太依賴一位客戶。
referenceEn: This company is too dependent on one customer.
The company is too dependent on a single customer.
rubricZh: be dependent on＋名詞，表示「依賴⋯」，on 不可少
寫 depends too much on 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 overwhelming 造一個句子，說說一件讓你覺得難以招架、或感受非常強烈的事。
referenceEn: The amount of work this week is overwhelming for me.
My first day in a new city was overwhelming.
rubricZh: overwhelming 表示「壓倒性的、難以招架的」，常放在 be 動詞後
說的是自己的經驗或感受（例如 me、my）
時態配合內容（例如 is、was）
